Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recfVFnXBwRsp6WLY.Bio: Steven A. Young holds an MSci and a PhD in theoretical physics, and now describes himself as an author, musician and natural philosopher. He is the author of A Fool's Wisdom: Science Conspiracies & The Secret Art of Alchemy, which critiques scientific materialism before presenting Hermetic alchemy as a science of transformation. Under the alias Hedflux he has produced electronic music since 2003, going full time in 2010 and founding the label Luminus Music, with a body of work collected in a 20 Year Legacy Collection of 88 tracks and 12 DJ mixes. He lives in Scotland, where he teaches Audio Alchemy, a synthesis of musical, scientific and Hermetic knowledge.
recfVFnXBwRsp6WLY.Name: Steven Young

recl1wvjyRP3XfBBu.Bio: Marty Leeds is a gematria researcher, author and preacher who founded The Gnostic Church and Academy of Lord Jesus Christ in 2022, where he serves as head teacher and spiritual leader. A working minister since 2011, he is the author of more than ten books, among them the Pi & The English Alphabet series, Scripture in the Stars, The Keys to the Tarot and Gnosticism Defined: The Tenets of The Order, built around a mathematical cipher he says is hidden beneath the English alphabet. His teaching centers on Prisca Theologia, the idea of a single wisdom underlying the world's religions, drawing together gematria, Kabbalah, astrology and comparative mythology. He streams weekly sermons free through the Gnostic Academy's YouTube and Rumble channels.
recl1wvjyRP3XfBBu.Name: Marty Leeds

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Polymath the Textbooks Skipped", "body": "Steven Young recounts finding Robert Fludd by working backwards from the alchemical engravings he was trying to decode, then recognizing his own biography in Fludd's: university, years touring as a musician, a return home to Scotland, and a plunge into alchemy. Both guests dwell on Fludd as physician, alchemist, artist, writer and man of God at once, a combination Young says the modern age no longer produces because we are all put in our own pigeon holes. They note the claim that William Harvey's account of blood circulation may owe something to Fludd's metaphysics, and that Fludd's ripples are still felt four centuries on."}, {"title": "Fludd Versus Kepler on Quantity and Quality", "body": "The conversation returns repeatedly to Fludd's printed quarrel with Johannes Kepler, described here as a gentlemanly rap battle fought through books. Chance Garton reads Fludd's rebuke of the vulgar mathematicians who measure the shadows instead of the substance, and his famous burn, he has hold of the tail, I grasp the head, I perceive the first cause, he is its effects. Garton frames the fight through Rene Guenon's The Reign of Quantity and The Signs of the Times, arguing the Iron Age is defined by obsession with quantity. Steven Young adds that music is where quantity becomes quality, since ratios are felt as feelings."}, {"title": "The Macrocosm as a Two Octave Monochord", "body": "Fludd's history of the macrocosm gets the closest reading of the episode. Young lays out the three heavens, Empyrean, Ethereal and Elemental, running from pure form to unformed matter with a perfect balance between. The talk then turns to Fludd's monochord model, a single string with God's hand on the tuning peg, fourteen divisions across the three worlds, four elemental, seven planetary and three empyrean, making two octaves. Marty Leeds hears 314 in that ordering as a reference to pi, and connects Fludd's defense of the quaternary number to the Tetragrammaton and the tetractys, where one, two, three and four sum to ten and the four contains everything."}, {"title": "The Light of the Mind and Healing at a Distance", "body": "Garton reads Fludd's claim that the mind is in no ways divided from the essence of God, but bound up with him as light is with the body of the sun, all souls holding a continuous relation to the one world soul or metatron. Fludd also places the Trinity in the sun itself, face as Father, light as Son, heat as Holy Spirit. Garton relates this to his own biofield tuning practice, saying remote sessions make sense only if life force energy is one indivisible continuum, and that so called psychic ability is a birthright rather than a special power. He describes people as peepholes for God."}, {"title": "Secret Societies, the Stone, and the Road Back to Christ", "body": "Fludd defended the Rosicrucians publicly yet, as Young understands it, was never admitted and never met a single brother, which prompts speculation that the order may have begun as a hoax. Young relays a 32nd degree correspondent's account of Freemasonry as ritual theater nobody is required to understand, and Leeds agrees the mysteries have been watered down. Young points to Adam McLean's list of roughly two hundred names for the philosopher's stone, one of them blood of Christ. Leeds cites Carl Jung reading the stone as the completion of the Christos, and both men describe science and number as their own path to Christ."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Marty Leeds (Gnostic Academy) and Steven Young (Hedflux) have something in common: they're both fascinated and inspired by the 16th-17th century Alchemist, Robert Fludd. In this episode, we explore the natural philosophy, musical cosmology, and metaphysics and divine sciences of one of history's greatest minds. Some topics include the infinite and indivisible God, Jesus: the light of the mind, Fludd's beef with Johannes Kepler, and the History of the Macrocosm.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: This conversation explores Robert Fludd's legendary debate with Johannes Kepler over quality versus quantity in science, his model of the cosmos as a divine monochord, the macrocosm and microcosm, the esoteric Christ as the light of the mind, Cabala and gematria, the philosopher's stone, memory palaces, and why Fludd's vision of consciousness as an indivisible emanation from God anticipated the modern hard problem of consciousness.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title":"Turning Matter Back Into Spirit","body":"Marty and Steven reframe alchemy as a two-way street: not just refining matter into spirit, but turning materialists into spiritualists. They trace this through the earth element, called the house of the devil because its density blocks light, and through the classic vitriol formula urging seekers to visit the interior of the earth and rectify what they find there. The Ouroboros, tail in the mouth of the serpent, becomes their symbol for how the lowest point of matter connects back to the highest point of spirit, and how nothing in creation is higher without also being lower."},{"title":"Quantum Physics Doesn't Hold Up","body":"Steven walks through his own presentation debunking quantum physics, leaning on Aristotle's idea that matter is a continuum rather than a pile of discrete parts. He argues there is no evidence of any smallest piece of anything, since every attempt to isolate a fundamental particle just reveals more particles beneath it. He extends the critique to instruments themselves: whatever a microscope or telescope shows is shaped by the tool, not by the senses, so the picture science produces is an artifice layered onto reality rather than reality seen directly, a case for humility about what physics claims to have proven."},{"title":"Christ as the Light of the Mind","body":"Reading between Fludd's lines, Marty argues Christ is less a historical man than an essence, the light of the mind that is Fludd's real subject throughout. Salvation becomes healing in this frame: the more a person lights up their internal self, the closer they move to a salvific state, since enlightenment is quite literally the light of one's own mind growing clearer. Marty ties this back to his own aphorism that the bottom is the top, that you have to get up to get down and down to get up, collapsing the distance between the highest spiritual truth and the lowest material starting point."},{"title":"Fludd's Case for the Philosopher's Stone","body":"With time running short, the group turns to Fludd's most famous claim, the philosopher's stone, reading his Truth's Golden Harrow where he describes it as a virgin elixir few are worthy to see. Steven notices the imagery is strikingly feminine, tying the stone to earth, to wisdom, and to a kind of Madonna and child union that produces the elixir. Marty adds the numerological angle, showing Metatron's Hebrew letters sum to 314, the same value as Shaddai, linking the stone to the divine name itself and to salt, sulfur, and mercury as the completion of the great work."},{"title":"Why Alchemy Led Them to Christ","body":"As the conversation winds down, Marty traces how gematria and alchemy pulled him toward founding his own church, since every thread he studied kept leading back to Christ, and Steven describes his own path through flat earth research and physics into the same conclusion. Both frame the philosopher's stone as another name for the completed self, Carl Jung's christos, rather than a literal chemical substance. Chance closes the thought simply: no one is separate from Christ or from God, there is no separation, only the illusion of one, which is the deepest lesson the whole conversation has been circling."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text":"I've realized that alchemy is not just about turning matter into spirit, it's about turning materialists into spiritualists.","author":"Chance Garton","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"This gets to the heart of alchemy, the vitriols, visit the interior of the earth and rectify what you find there.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"Nothing is higher unless it is lower, not thick unless it is thin.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"There's no evidence of any smallest piece of anything.","author":"Steven Young","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"Depending on the tool, you're going to see things the way that the tool sees things, not the way that your eyes would see things.","author":"Steven Young","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"Bottom is the top. Gotta get up to get down, gotta get down to get up, that's how I like to put it.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"When you really read between the lines with Fludd, he talks about Christ as more of an essence than a physical man.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"I suppose if you're talking about a stone, which would be earth, which is a feminine element, but I was also thinking about wisdom, which is always spoken about in feminine terms.","author":"Steven Young","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"In the Reign of Quantity, unity is replaced with uniformity, and that's exactly what's going on: under the name of unity, the world has become more and more uniform.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"Metatron in Hebrew is the letters Shin, Dalet, and Yod. Shin is 300, Dalet is four, and Yod is 10, that's 314.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"You're not separate from Christ, you're not separate from God. There is no separation, that's the illusion.","author":"Chance Garton","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"One of the main things that got me into starting a church, because I had been studying alchemy, and it kept leading back to Christ.","author":"Marty Leeds","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"For me, coming with alchemy and music, and even the flat earth stuff, that for me was like a scientific path to Christ.","author":"Steven Young","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "He was a man of God, an alchemist and a scientist, but also a brilliant artist, a brilliant writer. He seemed to be all these things together.", "author": "Steven Young", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "As far as we know, he actually wasn't a Rosicrucian, yet he was willing to openly defend it because as far as we could tell, he absolutely knew what it was actually about.", "author": "Marty Leeds", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Music is where quantity becomes quality because the frequencies and ratios are felt as feelings.", "author": "Steven Young", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "It seems that Fludd actually created his cosmology on his own to a large degree, in terms of the order of it and the greater pattern of it as a musical harmony of sorts.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Flux is actually a substance that extracts impurities when you're working with metals. So it completely changed the meaning of the term Head Flux now. So it's like extracting impurities from the head.", "author": "Steven Young", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's no actual separation between the light that's hitting us here and its source up there. And in the same way, the light of the mind is a continuous stream from God.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Carl Jung specifically said that when they were referring to the philosopher's stone, it wasn't a replacement. It was just another name for the completion of the Christos, or that great work through Christ.", "author": "Marty Leeds", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I was like looking for scientific understanding. And the deeper I went, the closer I got to Christ until I realized that everything's just pointing to that anyway.", "author": "Steven Young", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/64e99b71-cbdd-4d89-94d1-8fd9f020472c/STEVEN-YOUNG.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "You just keep going. You keep searching and keep searching and keep your nose to the grindstone. That's when the magic happens and you'll end up at the top of the mountain.", "author": "Marty Leeds", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/9317d892-142f-40f7-9891-729784cb3655/MARTY-LEEDS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's one life and that one life is the spirit that animates all life. So the plurality is a quantitative illusion of matter and the qualitative essential truth is that there's only the one life.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
